newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major's accuses Labour of Europe divisions.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major's accuses Labour of Europe divisions.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday that the opposition Labour Party was divided over Europe but had concealed this in campaigning for the May 1 election.
He said 40 or 50 Labour MPs were "antagonistic" towards the planned single European currency and they would "rediscover their voices" after the election.
"They have kept very quiet because they would like a Labour government," Major said in an interview with Britain's Channel Four television news.
